reason: I eat naengmyeon all the time back home, so on a one-week Waikiki trip I'd rather spend my meals on the places I already saved from blogs and Instagram. A Korean spot I just stumbled on, a ride away on Kapiolani where parking is a hassle, doesn't make the cut.
objection: It's food I can get anywhere at home, it isn't on my researched list, and $18.95 plus tax for cold noodles feels steep when I don't know whether it's actually good.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it recommended by a blog or Instagram account I trust as the best kudzu naengmyeon in Honolulu, with real photos of the bowl.
